newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers barely moved, discussion thin.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers barely moved, discussion thin.

text.p: Singapore bunker indications on Friday were little moved from Thursday as discussion were thin with few buyers seen as prices at other ports were considered to be more competitive, traders said on Friday.
Both bunker 180-cst and 380-cst prices were quoted unchanged from Thursday at $121-$123 and $116-$118 respectively.

A trader said rumours were heard that a local company might try to support cargo prices causing some shipowners to be sidelined. This has also contributed to the thin demand, he said. MDO prices were also little changed at $223-228 and gas oil at $234-$238. -- Singapore newsroom (+65-870-3082)
